title: Verbatim legal quotation check, blind

amendments.text:
## Re-hash note (before any engine call)

The first hash was taken at 2026-10-03T10:49:49Z. The run's own integrity check then stopped at KB01, before the engine
was called. Python had written the CAP texts with CRLF line endings but hashed them as LF. The CAP texts were rewritten
byte-exactly from the cached CAP JSON, with CAP's own `\n`, and the manifest now hashes raw bytes. No item, quotation,
source choice, rule or bar changed. `PREREG.sha256` holds both hash sets.

rerun.detail: The harness ships byte for byte, but the 57 opinion texts and 58 decision files it reads are named by path and sha256 in items/MANIFEST.json and are not in this tree, and it looks for the engine build at the authors' layout. The script that fetched the texts does not ship.

hash_list_note: PREREG.sha256 holds two hash sets, 42 seconds apart (2026-10-03T10:49:49Z and 10:50:31Z). The first was superseded before any engine call, when the run's own integrity check stopped on CRLF line endings in the opinion texts. Three lines changed between the sets and one was added: PREREG.md (its re-hash note added), items/MANIFEST.json (the per-text hashes, after the texts were rewritten with LF line endings and the manifest made to hash raw bytes), harness/build_manifest.py (the script that builds that manifest), and a new line for the script that fetched the texts. The first manifest's bytes were not kept, so this tree cannot show that no item changed between the two sets; that rests on the authors' re-hash note in PREREG.md. The run is held to the second set.
